original_text:
The distinguishing
characteristics of this architecture are the addition of residual connections between
convolution blocks and two changes to the convolution operator: (1) causality, which
guarantees no information leakage from future to past; and (2) dilation, which ``skips''
a fixed number of neighboring time-steps to have a wider view of the signal without
additional parameters \cite{DBLP:journals/corr/abs-1803-01271}.
